parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: New driving force $DF=12500/25=500\,\mathrm{N}$. Any one of: car, $DF-T-R=1500a$; trailer, $T-80=300a$; system, $DF-80-R=1800a$ — M1. Two correct equations — A1ft; $DF=500$ must be used, follow through on $R$. Solve two dimensionally correct simultaneous equations for $a$ and $T$, or solve the system equation for $a$ — M1. $a=0.111\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}$ (allow $1/9$) — A1. $T=113\,\mathrm{N}$ (allow $340/3$) — A1. Total: 5.
